gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: vomiting began 3 days ago. Generated HPI only notes vomiting as an initial symptom that has resolved; it does not state the onset was 3 days ago.

Gold: now has diarrhea 5–6x/day. Generated HPI-001: 3 days of profuse watery diarrhea, approximately 5–6 bowel movements per day. Frequency and presence are captured (onset difference originates from chief complaint, not in gold).
Gold: watery/loose stools. Generated HPI-001: profuse watery diarrhea; HPI-001/ROS-001 clearly indicate watery diarrhea, equivalent to watery/loose stools.

Gold: no blood in stools and no abdominal pain. Generated HPI-003: denies visible blood in stool; HPI-004: denies significant abdominal pain. These capture absence of blood and essentially no clinically significant abdominal pain.

Gold: reduced oral intake, not drinking sufficient fluids, feels dehydrated. Generated HPI-005: poor oral intake, feeling dehydrated and weak; this covers reduced intake and dehydration, though it does not explicitly say ‘not drinking sufficient fluids’ but is semantically equivalent.
Gold: appetite is reduced. Generated HPI-005 includes 'decreased appetite', which is equivalent.
Gold: no fever but feels warm and weak. Generated HPI-006: feeling a little warm at onset but no sustained fever; HPI-005: feeling weak. Together they cover absence of fever plus warmth and weakness.
Gold: denies headaches or muscle pain. Generated HPI-007: no headache or myalgias. This is equivalent.

Gold: unaware of triggers and no unwell contacts. Generated HPI-008: no known recent sick contacts or suspicious food exposure. This covers lack of sick contacts and, via lack of suspicious food exposure, approximates ‘unaware of triggers’.
Gold: history of asthma. Generated PMH-001: history of asthma. Direct match.

Gold: uses salbutamol inhaler PRN. Generated MED-001: uses a 'blue inhaler' infrequently as needed for asthma. This is effectively the same medication and PRN usage, though the name salbutamol is not repeated.
Gold: no known drug allergies. Generated ALLERGY-001: patient reports no known drug allergies. Directly covered.
Gold: father had hypertension and died of bowel cancer. Generated FH-001 covers hypertension; FH-002 covers father died of colorectal (bowel) cancer. Combined, they fully capture the gold fact.
Gold: mother has Type 2 diabetes. Generated FH-003: mother has type 2 diabetes mellitus. Direct match.
Gold: lives alone and works as software engineer. Generated SH-001: lives alone; SH-002: works as a software engineer. Together they cover the gold fact (generated also adds ‘off work 3 days’).
Gold: non-smoker and social alcohol. Generated SH-004: denies smoking; SH-003: drinks alcohol infrequently/socially. Fully covered.
Gold: impression is gastroenteritis. Generated ASM-001: acute watery diarrhea most consistent with acute gastroenteritis (likely viral). This includes the same impression.

Gold: supportive management including rest and increased fluids. Generated PLAN-001: supportive management recommended; PLAN-007: outpatient management with rest and fluid replacement at home. These together cover rest and fluids.
Gold: OTC oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) recommended. Generated PLAN-003: advised to use oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte). Directly matches.

Gold: recommended regular paracetamol. Generated PLAN-004: paracetamol as needed for fever/weakness. This differs in dosing schedule (PRN vs regular) so the gold concept of 'regular' dosing is not captured.
Gold: review in 7 days if not better. Generated FU-001: return if not improving in 1 week or earlier if worsening. This matches the 7-day review if not improving.

Gold: seek earlier review for worsening diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or reduced oral intake. Generated FU-001/PLAN-006/PLAN-005 suggest earlier/urgent care for worsening or dehydration, but do not explicitly mention these specific symptom triggers as in the gold fact; criteria differ and are more general/alternative, not a clear capture of the listed symptoms.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Chief complaint of diarrhea for 3 days is not present in the gold facts, which only specify vomiting starting 3 days ago and current diarrhea but not its duration.

Gold HPI-002: diarrhea 5–6 times/day. Generated: 3 days of profuse watery diarrhea, approximately 5–6 bowel movements/day. Frequency and watery consistency are supported; the 3-day duration of diarrhea itself is not stated in gold but aligns with the overall 3-day illness timeline, so the core diarrhea fact is supported while duration element is an addition.
Gold only states vomiting started 3 days ago and does not say it has resolved or that it occurred 'a couple of times'. Resolution and frequency are additional details not in gold.
Gold HPI-004: no blood in stools. Generated HPI-003: denies visible blood in stool. Directly aligns.
Gold HPI-004: no abdominal pain. Generated: denies significant abdominal pain. Clinically equivalent; 'significant' is a mild qualifier but not contradictory.

Gold HPI-005 and HPI-006: reduced oral intake, not drinking sufficient fluids, feels dehydrated; appetite reduced. Generated HPI-005: poor oral intake, feeling dehydrated and weak, decreased appetite. Directly supported; inclusion of weakness is also supported by gold HPI-007.

Gold HPI-007: no fever but feels warm. Generated: felt a little warm at onset but no sustained fever. This is consistent with no fever and feeling warm; specifying 'sustained' is an added nuance, not a contradiction.
Gold HPI-008: denies headaches/muscle pain. Generated HPI-007: no headache or myalgias. Identical clinically.

Gold HPI-009: unaware of triggers and no unwell contacts. Generated HPI-008: no recent sick contacts or suspicious food exposure. No sick contacts directly matches; lack of suspicious food exposure is a concrete form of 'unaware of triggers.'
Symptoms starting while at home working on computer is not stated in any gold fact; this is new contextual detail.

Gold ASM-001: impression is gastroenteritis; Plan-001: supportive management. Generated HPI-010: advised likely gastroenteritis and supportive care. This is consistent with the gold impression and plan.
Both gold and generated state a history of asthma.
Gold: salbutamol inhaler PRN. Generated: 'blue inhaler' used infrequently as needed for asthma. Clinically same PRN inhaler use; color descriptor is additional but not contradictory.
Gold: NKDA. Generated: no known drug allergies. Directly matches.
Gold: father had hypertension and died of bowel cancer. Generated FH-001 captures the hypertension portion accurately.
Gold: father died of bowel cancer. Generated FH-002: father died of colorectal cancer about 10 years ago. Cancer type is consistent; the '10 years ago' timing is an addition.
Gold: mother has Type 2 diabetes. Generated: mother has type 2 diabetes mellitus. Matches exactly.
Gold SH-001: lives alone. Generated SH-001: lives alone. Direct match.
Gold SH-001: works as a software engineer. Generated SH-002: works as a software engineer and has been off work 3 days. Occupation is supported; 'off work 3 days' is an addition.
Gold SH-002: drinks alcohol socially. Generated SH-003: drinks alcohol infrequently and socially. Social drinking is supported; 'infrequently' is added nuance.
Gold SH-002: non-smoker. Generated SH-004: denies smoking. Equivalent.

Gold ASM-001: impression gastroenteritis. Generated ASM-001: acute watery diarrhea most consistent with acute gastroenteritis (likely viral). Diagnosis of gastroenteritis is supported; 'likely viral' is an addition.
Differential diagnoses (viral vs bacterial gastroenteritis, foodborne illness, medication-related diarrhea, IBD) are not mentioned in gold; this is entirely additional reasoning.

Gold HPI-005: reduced oral intake, not drinking sufficient fluids, feels dehydrated. Generated ASM-003: subjective dehydration due to decreased oral intake and frequent watery stools. This interpretation is supported by the gold symptoms, though 'frequent watery stools' is drawn from gold HPI-002/003.
Gold only notes history of asthma (PMH-001); no statement that it is currently controlled or used infrequently. Current control status is additional.
Gold lists family history of bowel cancer and type 2 diabetes but does not comment on relevance for screening/risk. That interpretive statement is additional.

Gold Plan-001: supportive management including rest and fluids. Generated Plan-001: supportive management recommended. Supported, though generated does not repeat 'rest/fluids' here (these appear in Plan-007).
Gold plan mentions only supportive care, ORS, paracetamol; no statement about tests or stool studies. The decision not to order tests and to consider stool studies later is new content.
Gold Plan-002: recommended OTC Dioralyte. Generated Plan-003: advised to use oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte). Matches.

Gold Plan-003: recommended regular paracetamol. Generated Plan-004: paracetamol as needed for fever/weakness. 'Regular' dosing vs PRN are opposed management instructions, so this conflicts with the gold plan.
Monitoring fluid intake, urine output, dizziness, high fevers, increased stool frequency, or bloody stools is not described in the gold plan/follow-up details. These are added safety instructions.

Advice to seek urgent care for moderate-severe dehydration or high fever is not explicitly in gold; gold only mentions earlier review for worsening symptoms (specific GI symptoms). This urgent-care threshold is additional detail.
Gold Plan-001: supportive management including rest and increased fluids. Generated Plan-007: outpatient management with rest and fluid replacement at home. This is directly supported.
Instruction to remain off work until diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours (with extra days off) is not present in any gold fact. Entirely additional.

Gold FU-001: review in 7 days if not better. Generated FU-001: return if not improving in 1 week or earlier if worsening. The 1-week review is supported; 'earlier if worsening' is elaborated beyond gold FU-001 but conceptually overlaps with gold FU-002.
Work exclusion until diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours is not mentioned in any gold follow-up instruction; this is new guidance.
Gold HPI-002/003: current watery/loose diarrhea. Generated ROS-001: ROS positive for watery diarrhea. Consistent and supported.
Gold HPI-001: patient developed vomiting 3 days ago. Generated ROS-002: ROS positive for prior vomiting. This is supported (though ROS does not specify timing).
Gold HPI-004: no blood in stools. Generated ROS-003: ROS negative for blood in stool. Direct match.
Gold HPI-004: no abdominal pain. Generated ROS-004: notes minimal abdominal pain. Presence of any abdominal pain contradicts the gold statement of no abdominal pain.
Gold HPI-007: patient feels weak. Generated ROS-005: ROS notes weakness. Supported.

Gold HPI-007: no fever but feels warm. Generated ROS-006: subjective fever at onset. This reframes feeling warm as subjective fever; while wording differs, it does not assert an objective fever and is reasonably aligned with the gold description of feeling warm without documented fever.
Gold facts contain no information on current respiratory complaints. Statement of 'no acute respiratory complaints today' is new.
Gold notes history of asthma as PMH, not within ROS. Mentioning asthma in the ROS respiratory line is structural/sectional detail not described in gold; treated as additional.
